name: Build a lesson from explanation to practice and a quiz
why: Builds a lesson with worked examples, practice and a quiz in one pass, the same order as the lesson plan skill.

name: Check a lesson before teaching it
why: Reviews a finished plan for overload and barriers before it is taught, a good last check after the lesson plan skill.

name: Lesson opener planner
why: Plans a five-minute starter linked to last lesson, matching the daily review step in the lesson plan skill.

name: Class quiz reteach keeper
why: Turns quiz results into what to reteach and checks next time whether it worked, like the exit-ticket reteach prompt.

name: Recall quiz writer
why: Writes low-stakes recall quizzes at three levels from lesson notes, useful for the weekly review in the lesson pack.

name: Task rubric drafter
why: Drafts a rubric with clear wording at each level, a quick start before the two-marker check in the assessment skill.

name: Student work marking desk
why: Marks a batch of work against one rubric with feedback, once the rubric from the assessment skill is agreed; the teacher confirms marks.

name: Mark student work against a rubric and sharpen your feedback
why: Finds gaps and causes in student work against a goal and rubric, for the reteach step after a unit test.

name: Adapt a lesson for different access needs
why: Reviews barriers and adapts activities while keeping the goal unchanged, the same principle as the adapted materials skill.

name: Teach students to check AI answers and set fair rules
why: Ready lessons on AI reliability and class AI rules, which fits England's planned AI literacy content.

name: Prepare a webinar people can follow
why: Plans one webinar around a clear result with an outline and slides, for each session in the member education year.

name: Monthly course lesson keeper
why: Finds stale or hard-to-follow lessons in a running course each month, useful for the termly review in year planning.
